title: 09/01/17 - Software Updates
text:
## 09/01/17 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034904
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

## Updates:
We added support for the Recurring Events Add-On on the Recent Event streaming widget for the homepage. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Events
The Sidebar Modules Search Widgets are now based on text labels. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Blog Article Search Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Coupons Search Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Events Search Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Jobs Search Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Photo Album Search Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Products Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Classifieds Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Coupons Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Event Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Jobs Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Member Article Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Photo Albums Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Products Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Videos Search
The Edit Post Button in the Admin >> Content >> Manage Post Section is now working as it should.
We fixed an issue that was affecting the Lead Email Templates content formatting.
